column1: # Nickname corpus (QA-owned). Spec: README (2-12 letters/digits, profanity-checked) and docs/protocol.md 9.3
# (NFKC, trim, every character a Unicode letter or digit, listed profanity anywhere, reserved names).
# expect: VALID      accepted; 'stored' (if not '-') is the exact nickname the server must store and return.
#         INVALID    400 invalid_nickname. reason: LENGTH | CHARSET | INVISIBLE | RESERVED (informational).
#         EITHER     undecided by the spec (see DEFECTS.md); only 'no crash, no 500, nothing stored un-normalized'.
# QA rules beyond the spec text (DEF-007): length counts code points after NFKC; Hangul fillers U+3164/U+115F/U+1160/U+FFA0
# are letters in Unicode but render blank and must be rejected (INVISIBLE).
# Format: UTF-8, tab-separated, '#' starts a comment line, first non-comment line is the header.
# Escapes in text columns (decoded by the QA loaders, QaCorpus.kt):
#   \R[N:TEXT] repeats TEXT N times (inside TEXT write \] for ']').
# Invisible, control, bidi and confusable characters are ALWAYS written as escapes so a reviewer can see them;
# QaCorporaWellFormedTest fails if a raw invisible/control/bidi character appears in this file.

column6: compatibility jamo are letters and must be stored as typed (plain NFKC turns them into conjoining jamo; DEF-035)
two compatibility jamo must not be composed into the syllable 가 by NFKC (DEF-035)
prolonged sound mark U+30FC is a letter (Lm)
same 12 syllables as 24 conjoining jamo: length counted after normalization
12 supplementary CJK characters = 24 UTF-16 units: length is code points (DEF-007)
circled digit folded to 1 by NFKC
roman numeral folded to XII by NFKC
digits only are allowed by the spec (display 1234#0420 is odd; DEF-007)
mathematical bold letters folded by NFKC
11 before NFKC, 14 after (U+337F expands to 4 letters)
ligature expands to 2 letters after NFKC: length is measured after normalization
NFKC gives 1 FRACTION SLASH 2: the slash is a symbol
U+FDFA expands to a phrase with spaces under NFKC
leading zero-width space (not removed by trim)
Hangul filler x2: Unicode letters that render blank (blank nickname)
'operator' in Korean: localized reserved names undefined
half-width; NFKC gives バカヤロウ
Armenian seh U+057D looks like u inside a Latin name
substring rule may reject it; acceptable for names
Thai with combining vowel signs (Mn): rejected by a strict letter rule; not a target language
